bullets.text: Samsung Expands Refurbished Program - **Samsung** brings its Certified Re-Newed program to the **UK**, enhancing eco-friendly phone options.
Meta Shuts Down Work Metaverse - **Meta** discontinues Horizon Workrooms, signaling a shift in its metaverse strategy.
AI Journalism Deal with News Corp - **Symbolic.ai** partners with **News Corp** to enhance financial news delivery.
Spotify Raises Subscription Prices - **Spotify** increases its monthly subscription fee in the **US**, marking the third hike in three years.
Wikimedia Partners with Tech Giants - **Wikimedia Foundation** announces new AI partnerships with **Amazon**, **Meta**, and **Microsoft**.
Verizon Outage Affects Millions - A **Verizon** network outage impacted around 2 million customers for over 8 hours.
Taiwan Invests in US Semiconductors - Taiwan commits $250 billion to bolster **US** semiconductor manufacturing.
AI Video Startup Hits $1.3B Valuation - **Higgsfield**, an AI video startup, secures a $1.3 billion valuation amid rapid growth.
